description: NaBaCr₂F₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.96 Å. Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.71-3.05 Å. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-45°. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.96 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-45°. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.97 Å. There are nine inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ba, and one Cr atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Cr atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Cr atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ba, and one Cr atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Cr atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Cr atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Cr atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two Cr atoms. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Cr atom.
